The contractor will co-design and implement development packages with partners, adapting to each institution\"s context. Flexibility is key due to possible political changes or restructuring. normalized.title: Ireland – Global navigation and positioning systems (GPS or equivalent) – Supply of Robotic Total Station Surveying Equipment for Tailte Éireann
normalized.description: Supply of Robotic Total Stations for Tailte Éireann’s surveying activities. The proposed robotic total station solutions should consist of all its necessary components such as a lightweight detail pole, bipod for telescopic pole, tripod for total station, clamps, Li-On batteries, power cables, bags etc. and should be supplied with a rugged carrying case designed to protect the equipment during transportation and when not in use. The total stations should be capable of capturing topographic detail using reflectorless measurements and should have the ability to track a target robotically.
